biotools.summary: The Spinal Cord Toolbox (SCT) is an open-source library for analyzing multi-parametric MRI of the spinal cord. It includes templates, atlases, and scripts for data preprocessing, registration, and segmentation, facilitating the quantification of spinal cord morphology and its relationship to sensorimotor function.
